Verify that the [DONE] sentinel signal properly terminates the stream

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from liter_llm import create_client
from liter_llm._internal_bindings import ChatCompletionRequest

async def main() -> None:
    client = create_client(api_key=os.environ["API_KEY"])
    req = ChatCompletionRequest.from_json('{"messages":[{"content":"Say done","role":"user"}],"model":"gpt-4","stream":true}')
    result = client.chat_stream(req)
    chunks = []
    async for chunk in result:
        chunks.append(chunk)
    print(result)

asyncio.run(main())
```
